Its association with Ailean nam Bi, a mythical goddess of the island, adds an element of mystique and allure. In Scotland, it is not uncommon to find places bearing the name Ailsa, such as Ailsa Craig, a small Hebridean island renowned for its distinctive basalt cliffs.
